title: Tiers list shows 50 tiers a page
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have at least 51 active tiers in the client (make new ones for this test if needed), so the list needs a second page.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Tiers tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Go to the list's second page.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The first page shows 50 tiers, Default first.

Step 2:

  • The second page shows the tiers after the 50th (51 − 50 = 1 or more).
  • Every tier made for this test is listed; none was refused.
